caveats: Counts are drawn from the structurally contestable subset. Tasks longer than any window on their corridor are impossible for both algorithms and are excluded.

Baseline block utilisation is HIGHER than the optimizer's because it over-subscribes windows. Never render utilisation without the double-booking count beside it.
